title: From Stance to Concern: Adaptation of Propositional Analysis to New Tasks and Domains
reasoning: The paper's core objective is to detect 'concerns', which it defines as topical issues with moral dimensions. It utilizes and expands lexicons based on Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) to evaluate how well NLP systems can identify moral values such as care/harm, fairness/cheating, and loyalty/betrayal.
